params.name: zoom
params.description: Zoom level. Z coordinate in the XYZ tiling scheme

params.name: x
params.description: X coordinate in the XYZ tiling scheme. Must be less than 2^zoom

params.name: y
params.description: Y coordinate in the XYZ tiling scheme. Must be less than 2^zoom

params.name: color
params.description:
Primary color to use in tile creation. Accepts common colors by string
(e.g. `color=blue`), and accepts escaped color HEX codes
(e.g. `color=%2386a91c`)

params.name: acc
params.description: Whether or not positional accuracy / coordinate uncertainty has been specified

params.name: captive
params.description: Captive or cultivated observations

params.name: endemic
params.description: Observations whose taxa are endemic to their location

params.name: geo
params.description: Observations that are georeferenced

params.name: id_please
params.description: Observations with the deprecated `ID, Please!` flag. Note that this will return observations, but that this attribute is no longer used.

params.name: identified
params.description: Observations that have community identifications

params.name: introduced
params.description: Observations whose taxa are introduced in their location

params.name: mappable
params.description: Observations that show on map tiles

params.name: native
params.description: Observations whose taxa are native to their location

params.name: out_of_range
params.description: Observations whose taxa are outside their known ranges

params.name: pcid
params.description:

the `project_id` parameter is also specified, this will only consider
observations identified by curators of the specified project(s)

params.name: photos
params.description: Observations with photos

params.name: popular

params.name: sounds

params.name: taxon_is_active

params.name: threatened

params.name: verifiable
